First version. ; ;- PRO red_generate_docs ; 1. Add IDLdoc to the GDL path !PATH = './idldoc/src/:' + !PATH ; 2. Explicitly create the output directory FILE_MKDIR, 'out-docs' ; 3. Get the absolute path to the current directory CD, CURRENT=current_dir PRINT, '--- IDLdoc Root Directory: ', current_dir ; 4. Run IDLdoc using the absolute path for ROOT idldoc, ROOT=current_dir, $ OUTPUT='out-docs/', $ TITLE='RED Project Documentation' ; 5. Fallback: If IDLdoc placed files in an html/ subfolder, move them up IF FILE_TEST('out-docs/html/index.html') THEN BEGIN FILE_COPY, 'out-docs/html/*', 'out-docs/', /OVERWRITE ENDIF EXIT END
